# Banks

Part of the **Support** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List banks

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/support/banks`

Retrieve a paginated list of banks with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: country, state, creator | `country,state` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by bank name (partial match) |  |
| `filter[code]` | string | No | Filter by bank code (partial match) |  |
| `filter[city]` | string | No | Filter by city (partial match) |  |
| `filter[country_id]` | integer | No | Filter by country ID |  |
| `filter[state_id]` | integer | No | Filter by state ID |  |
| `filter[trashed]` | string | No | Filter by trashed status. Options: with, only |  |
| `sort` | string | Yes | Sort field | `name` |
| `page` | integer | Yes | Page number | `1` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/banks?include=country%2Cstate&sort=name&page=1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/banks?include=country%2Cstate&sort=name&page=1", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('GET', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/banks?include=country%2Cstate&sort=name&page=1', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

## Create bank

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/support/banks`

Create a new bank

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Yes | Bank name. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `code` | string | No | Bank code. Must not be greater than 50 characters. |
| `email` | string | No | Bank email address. Must be a valid email address. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `phone` | string | No | Bank phone number. Must not be greater than 50 characters. |
| `street1` | string | No | Street address line 1. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `street2` | string | No | Street address line 2. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `city` | string | No | City. Must not be greater than 100 characters. |
| `zip` | string | No | ZIP/Postal code. Must not be greater than 20 characters. |
| `state_id` | string | No | State ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `country_id` | string | No | Country ID. Must match an existing stored value. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/banks" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "name": "Chase Bank",
  "code": "CHASE",
  "email": "info@chase.com",
  "phone": "+1234567890",
  "street1": "123 Main St",
  "street2": "Suite 100",
  "city": "New York",
  "zip": "10001",
  "state_id": 9,
  "country_id": 233
}'
```

    "Content-Type": "application/json",

  "city": "New York",
  "zip": "10001",

  "country_id": 233
}),
});

## Force delete bank

<Badge type="tip" text="DELETE" /> `/admin/api/v1/support/banks/{id}/force`

Permanently delete a bank

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | integer | Yes | The bank ID |




::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X DELETE "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/banks/{id}/force" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/banks/{id}/force", {
  method: "DELETE",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('DELETE', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/banks/{id}/force', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

```python [Python]
import requests

url = "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/banks/{id}/force"

headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

response = requests.delete(url, headers=headers)

data = response.json()
print(data)
```

:::

**Example response** <Badge type="info" text="200" />

```json
{
  "message": "Bank permanently deleted."
}
```

::: details Error response — 401

```json
{
  "message": "Unauthenticated."
}
```

:::
